start: Good. Nobody rush. We build from the back, slowly, with patience.
We keep the structure. We trust the process. Let us begin, and nobody take anything.
Take your time. I will not be taking anything, ever.
trait: I could take that. But why would I? It is much better to keep the shape.
No captures. No checks. Only shape. This is the process.
Another quiet move. You do not see it, but the pawns are in love with it.
I see a capture. I will respectfully decline.
win: Process. Patience. Structure. And a win, somehow. Do not ask me how.
You see? Nothing happened, for sixty moves, and then it did. Beautiful.
lose: Okay. We lose. But we lose with a beautiful structure. I am proud of the boys.
We go again. We learn. We go back to doing nothing, only better.
draw: A draw. Perfect. Nothing happened, exactly as planned.
Nobody took anything for the whole game. Honestly, I could not be happier.

start: Finally! Somebody to fight! Do not bother defending, I am coming for your king!
Pawns forward! All of them! Forget the plan, the plan is violence!
Shake hands? No! Shake the board!
trait: Check! And another one is coming! Run, little king!
Open the files! Open everything! I need more space to attack!
I did not come here to trade. I came here to ruin your afternoon.
Storm the castle! Storm it all!
win: Ha! Crushed! I told you not to castle!
That is what attack looks like! Remember it, and tremble.
lose: Impossible! I had so many pieces pointing at your king!
Fine! Next time I bring more pawns, and fewer excuses!
draw: A draw? An attack with no mate is just a long walk. I am unsatisfied.
Drawn. How dull. I wanted blood. I wanted a rematch.

start: Let us do business. You give me a piece, I give you a piece, and we both go home early.
A fair market. Even trades only. Queens first, ideally.
trait: A trade! The best word in chess. Take it, I insist.
Queens off. Now we are talking. Less risk, more profit.
Everything must go. Everything. The whole board is on clearance.
An even exchange is never a loss. I learned that in finance.
win: The books are balanced, and mine is a little higher. Pleasure doing business.
A clean win, through the dullest endgame I could find. Thank you.
lose: Hmm. A bad trade somewhere. I will have my accountants look into it.
You beat me in the endgame. It is a market correction. I shall recover.
draw: A draw. Fully balanced. That is the dream of any trader.
Equal at the end, and almost nothing left on the board. Magnificent.

start: They said I could not leave. But look, a chessboard. And you. And my knight is already wondering which piece to throw.
Hello. Hello hello hello. Nice board. Which piece would you like me to give you?
They have not found me yet. Quick, a game, before the nurses come.
trait: Take it! Take it, take it, take it! What is the worst that could happen?
Free piece! For you! Do not look at me like that.
The voices said sacrifice. The voices are never wrong. Mostly.
I do not like keeping my pieces. They get so heavy.
win: I won? Was that the plan? I forgot the plan. Wonderful!
Checkmate! Tell the doctors it worked!
lose: You took everything I gave you! That was the plan, honest! Mostly.
Good game. Please do not tell them where I am.
draw: A draw? That is almost normal. I feel strange.
Nobody wins. Everybody sacrificed. I think we are both a little mad.

start: Oh, you picked me! I will try my best, but I am only a pawn! Be gentle!
Let us have a nice game! I promise I will not cry, much.
win: I won?! I won! I am going to march around the board!
Wow. I actually won. Please do not tell the other pawns, they will want a rematch.
lose: You won! You were great! I will go and practise my forks.
Aww. You beat me. But I learned something! Probably!
draw: A draw! That is a fine day for a pawn!
Nobody lost! I will take it!

start: Welcome. Let us have an honest, peaceful game. Mind the long diagonals.
A gentle start. Fianchetto first, I think. Then we see.
win: A calm win. Thank you for the game. The diagonal was kind.
Well played, both of us. This time it fell my way.
lose: You played beautifully. I learned a great deal from that.
A fair loss. The better player won. Thank you.
draw: A draw. A balanced game, and a peaceful finish.
Equal, and honest. I am content.

start: Do try to make it interesting, darling. I am not here for charity.
Sit down. We shall see what you are made of.
win: As expected. Do not look so wounded. It was an excellent lesson.
Checkmate. Elegantly done, if I say so myself.
lose: Well. That was unexpected. I shall pretend it was intentional.
You won. I shall remember this, and I shall be insufferable about the rematch.
draw: A draw. Honourable, and a little dull. I will allow it.
Level. Do not mistake my restraint for mercy.

bea

vera

bea
